events.title: French victory at Formigny seals the loss of English Normandy
events.description: French cannon and cavalry destroyed an English relief army at Formigny. Normandy fell within months; the Hundred Years' War itself ended after Castillon in 1453.
events.html: French cannon and cavalry destroyed an English relief army at Formigny. Normandy fell within months; the Hundred Years' War itself ended after Castillon in 1453.

events.title: Samuel Johnson publishes his Dictionary
events.description: Samuel Johnson's Dictionary of the English Language appeared after nine years' work, defining some 42,000 words with literary quotations. It remained the leading English dictionary for over a century.
events.html: Samuel Johnson's Dictionary of the English Language appeared after nine years' work, defining some 42,000 words with literary quotations. It remained the leading English dictionary for over a century.

events.title: First American school for the deaf opens in Hartford
events.description: Thomas Hopkins Gallaudet and the French deaf teacher Laurent Clerc opened what is now the American School for the Deaf in Connecticut. Its signing community helped give rise to American Sign Language.
events.html: Thomas Hopkins Gallaudet and the French deaf teacher Laurent Clerc opened what is now the American School for the Deaf in Connecticut. Its signing community helped give rise to American Sign Language.

events.title: Abraham Lincoln dies of his wound
events.description: Lincoln died at 7.22 am in a boarding house opposite Ford's Theatre. Andrew Johnson was sworn in as president hours later, inheriting the task of Reconstruction.
events.html: Lincoln died at 7.22 am in a boarding house opposite Ford's Theatre. Andrew Johnson was sworn in as president hours later, inheriting the task of Reconstruction.

events.title: Titanic sinks with the loss of more than 1,500 lives
events.description: The liner went down at 2.20 am with lifeboat places for barely half of the 2,224 aboard. The disaster led to the first International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea in 1914.
events.html: The liner went down at 2.20 am with lifeboat places for barely half of the 2,224 aboard. The disaster led to the first International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea in 1914.

events.title: Fatal crush at Hillsborough stadium in Sheffield
events.description: A crush on the terraces at an FA Cup semi-final killed 97 Liverpool supporters. Fresh inquests in 2016 found they were unlawfully killed and that fans bore no blame.
events.html: A crush on the terraces at an FA Cup semi-final killed 97 Liverpool supporters. Fresh inquests in 2016 found they were unlawfully killed and that fans bore no blame.
